idea: Divide the voltage equation by the nonzero impedance, then simplify the resulting complex quotient using I² = −1.
proof:
have hn : (2 - Complex.I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  have hr := congrArg Complex.re hz
  norm_num at hr
have hq : i = (1 + Complex.I) / (2 - Complex.I) := by
  apply (eq_div_iff hn).2
  rw [← h₂, ← h₀, h₁]
rw [hq]
apply (div_eq_iff hn).2
have hI : Complex.I ^ 2 = -1 := Complex.I_sq
linear_combination (3 / 5 : ℂ) * hI
insight_proof:
have hn : (2 - Complex.I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  have hr := congrArg Complex.re hz
  norm_num at hr
apply (eq_div_iff hn).2
rw [← h₂, ← h₀, h₁]
